posts.title: Notes from Hamel Husain's experience designing eval interviews
posts.description: A high eval score can hide a broken test. Hamel Husain's seven-part interview structure shows how to inspect the data, explain experiments, and make a product decision as engineering and data science roles overlap.

posts.title: The Eval Pyramid, Part III: Trace One Failure from Fixture to Release Gate
posts.description: Reproduce the refund agent that said "refunded" when it hadn't, watch a ledger check and a critical gate block it, then fix the bug and rerun. A walkthrough of the open-source Eval Pyramid Starter, one failure at a time.

posts.title: The Eval Pyramid, Part II: Measuring Agent Reliability with pass@k, pass^k, and Judges You Can Trust
posts.description: One passing trial says a system can succeed. Repeated trials, computed per task, say whether people can depend on it. Here's how to read pass@1, pass@k and pass^k, why the same 75% can describe two opposite systems, and how to check a model judge before it gates a release.
